description: This file defines the SearchResults class in the SuiteCRM\Search namespace, which manages search result data, including retrieving beans, formatting data for display, and handling related links within the SuiteCRM system.

classes.name: SearchResults
classes.description: Class that holds search results and metadata, provides methods to retrieve and format search hits as beans, and manages related links and display formatting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SearchResults object with hits, grouping flag, search time, total hits, scores, and options.

methods.name: getHits
methods.description: Returns the raw search hits data.

methods.name: getHitsAsBeans
methods.description: Retrieves search hits as loaded SugarBean objects, repairing index if necessary.

methods.name: formatForDisplay
methods.description: Formats bean fields for display, handling enums, multienums, and currency fields.

methods.name: updateFieldDefLinks
methods.description: Updates related links in a bean based on field definitions.

methods.name: updateObjLinks
methods.description: Updates related record links in a bean for display.

methods.name: getRelatedId
methods.description: Resolves related record IDs for linked beans.

methods.name: getLink
methods.description: Generates an HTML link for a record.

methods.name: getScores
methods.description: Returns the scores indicating relevance of hits.

methods.name: getModuleTotal
methods.description: Returns total hits for a specific module.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Returns a specific search option by key.

methods.name: getSearchTime
methods.description: Returns the time taken to perform the search.

methods.name: isGroupedByModule
methods.description: Indicates if hits are grouped by module.

methods.name: getLargestHitsCount
methods.description: Returns the largest number of hits among all modules.
